name: Zara Larsson
description:
'''Zara Maria Larsson''' ({{IPA|sv|ˈsɑ̂ːra ˈlɑ̌ːʂɔn|lang|sv-Zara Larsson.ogg}}; born 16 December 1997) is a Swedish singer and songwriter. She first rose to prominence in 2008 after winning the [[Talang 2008|second season]] of the Swedish talent show competition ''{{lang|sv|[[Talang (Swedish TV show)|Talang]]}}''. After signing with [[Ten Music Group]], she released her debut [[extended play]] (EP), ''Introducing'' (2013), which featured her first Swedish number-one single, "[[Uncover (song)|Uncover]]". Her debut studio album, ''[[1 (Zara Larsson album)|1]]'' (2014), produced the Swedish top-ten singles "[[Carry You Home (Zara Larsson song)|Carry You Home]]" and "[[Rooftop (song)|Rooftop]]".

After transitioning to [[Epic Records]], Larsson achieved an international breakthrough with her second studio album, ''[[So Good (Zara Larsson album)|So Good]]'' (2017). The album was led by a string of successful singles, including its lead single "[[Lush Life (Zara Larsson song)|Lush Life]]", which became one of the best-selling songs of the 2010s in the United Kingdom, as well as "[[Never Forget You (Zara Larsson and MNEK song)|Never Forget You]]" (with [[MNEK]]), "[[Ain't My Fault]]", and "[[I Would Like]]". She later scored her first UK number-one single from featuring on [[Clean Bandit]]'s 2017 single "[[Symphony (Clean Bandit song)|Symphony]]".  Larsson found further commercial success in Europe with her next studio album, ''[[Poster Girl (album)|Poster Girl]]'' (2021), and its lead single "[[Ruin My Life]]".

In 2022, Larsson left Ten Music Group and acquired her music catalogue. Her fourth studio album, ''[[Venus (Zara Larsson album)|Venus]]'' (2024), became her first major release under her own label, Sommer House. She also made her acting debut in the Swedish [[Netflix]] drama ''[[A Part of You]]'' (2024). In 2025, she released her fifth studio album, ''[[Midnight Sun (Zara Larsson album)|Midnight Sun]]'', to widespread critical acclaim. Its [[Midnight Sun (Zara Larsson song)|title track]] became Larsson's highest charting solo entry on the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]], and earned her a [[Grammy Award]] nomination for [[Grammy Award for Best Dance Pop Recording|Best Dance Pop Recording]]. The following year, her collaboration with [[PinkPantheress]], "[[Stateside (song)#Zara Larsson remix|Stateside + Zara Larsson]]", topped the [[Billboard Global 200|''Billboard'' Global 200]]. 

In Sweden, Larsson has achieved a total of five number one singles on the [[Sverigetopplistan]] chart, three number one albums, with her EP [[Honor the Light|''Honor the Light'']] (2023) also topping the charts. [[List of awards and nominations received by Zara Larsson|She is the recipient of]] two [[American Music Awards]], a [[Bambi Award]], four [[Grammis]] awards, four [[MTV Europe Music Awards]], and has been nominated for four [[Brit Awards]] and a [[Grammy Awards|Grammy Award]].
